lines.text: Every Monday morning you ask an agent to audit your dependencies.
And every Monday, you remember late, or you forget the whole thing.
An agent never reminds you. It waits to be asked, and then it does the work.
With Agent R Q, you can schedule a task to run at exactly the time you choose.
Run it just once, tonight at two a.m., while you sleep.
Or make it repeat, on a cron schedule.
Every weekday at nine, the dependency audit starts all by itself.
Each run lands on your dashboard as a normal task, with its own history.
You can review a run, reply to it, or ask the agent a follow up question.
And when it needs permission, it asks you first, even at two in the morning.
You stop remembering, and the schedule does the remembering for you.
Tests, audits, reports, cleanups. Anything you do every week can run on a clock.
What chore would you hand your agents every single week? Drop it in the comments, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
